verdict.rationale: LightSprint's pricing page claims you can run it in your own infrastructure or private cloud, so self-hosting is a first-party capability. The evidence is a single marketing line with no deployment documentation, and its placement on the pricing page suggests it may be limited to a higher plan. missing for 10: self-hosting/deployment documentation (install steps, requirements, supported components), clarity on which tier or license includes it, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a working self-hosted deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Run LightSprint in your own infrastructure or private cloud environment to fit stricter security and network requirements.
